About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

Branch is a workforce payments platform that helps employers pay their people faster and more flexibly, including earned wage access, digital pay cards, and tip payouts. Much of how we reach customers runs through partners: the payroll, HR, and workforce management systems employers already use, the point-of-sale platforms and resellers that serve hospitality, the technology providers and consultants that serve banks and credit unions, and the referral partners that send us warm introductions.

The Partner Account Manager owns Branch's partnership strategy and the partner relationships behind it. You decide where partners can create the most value for Branch, build the plan to get there, and run the day-to-day relationships that turn partners into pipeline and revenue. This is a builder's role: you will set direction, open new channels, deepen the partnerships we already have, and put the operations in place to track and pay partners properly. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Integrations, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to get it done.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own the partnership strategy: define where Branch should play, build the roadmap, and earn leadership buy-in
  • Turn strategy into a working plan: target lists by channel, outreach materials, outbound sequences, and activity goals tied to pipeline
  • Open new partner channels, including reseller networks and banking consultancies, for co-selling, lead generation, and co-marketing
  • Serve as the primary contact for a portfolio of revenue-generating partners, building relationships beyond technical contacts into each partner's alliances and partnerships leadership
  • Grow partners from referral relationships into integrated and go-to-market aligned partnerships, and introduce them to the full Branch product line
  • Own the business relationship with the payroll, HR, and point-of-sale platforms Branch integrates with, so new integrations get built and existing ones stay reliable
  • Lead account planning and quarterly business reviews with key partners, covering performance, pipeline, and risk
  • Analyze Branch's partner and integration coverage against competitors and recommend where to invest
  • Keep partner pipeline, activity, and performance current in HubSpot, report partner-sourced pipeline monthly, and make sure partner commissions and revenue share are paid accurately and on time

Qualifications (required):

  • 3+ years in partnerships, channel, alliances, or partner account management at a B2B SaaS or fintech company
  • Experience building or significantly expanding a partner channel or program, with a track record of partner-sourced pipeline and revenue
  • Familiarity with payroll, HR technology, workforce management, or point-of-sale ecosystems; experience with earned wage access, payments, or banking partnerships is a plus
  • Ability to negotiate commercial agreements and manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to work with senior executives at partner organizations
  • A data-driven approach: comfortable setting targets, measuring against them, and recommending where to stop investing
  • Working knowledge of CRM and PRM tools (HubSpot/Euler or similar)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, high-growth environment

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $100-110k, plus a commissions component. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc.

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits: 

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance 
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together.  Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others.  

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.
